The Havit MS73 Gaming Mouse with Side Button is designed for gamers and PC users who want comfort, precision, and added control. Featuring an adjustable DPI up to 3600, this wired gaming mouse delivers accurate tracking and smooth cursor movement for FPS, MOBA, RTS games, and everyday tasks.

With dedicated back and forward buttons, the MS73 enhances productivity while also providing faster navigation during gaming or browsing sessions. The vibrant LED lighting adds an attractive gaming aesthetic that complements your PC setup, while the ergonomic design ensures comfort even during long hours of use.

Its stable USB wired connection guarantees responsive performance with minimal latency. Whether you’re gaming, browsing, or working, the Havit MS73 offers reliable performance at an affordable price.
